_note: 원문 유형은 문장 삽입. insert 유형을 가장 강하게 출제. 유형마다 passage 를 다르게 paraphrase.

passage: Roughly 15 to 20 percent of the world's greenhouse gases come from forest loss and decline.
Trees are central players in the carbon cycle.
Through photosynthesis they turn carbon dioxide into oxygen, acting as natural regulators of CO2.
More trees therefore mean less carbon dioxide and more oxygen in the air.
Sadly, cutting down forests stops this process from working as it should.
With half of Earth's forests already gone, the level of carbon dioxide keeps climbing.
More CO2 traps more of the sun's heat, and so the planet's average temperature rises.
choices: why trees grow faster in regions with more sunlight
how oxygen is transported across the world's oceans
why photosynthesis slows down during the cold winter months
how deforestation raises carbon dioxide and drives global warming
how planting flowers can cool down a crowded city
theme.explanation_ko: 나무는 광합성으로 CO2를 산소로 바꿔 조절하지만, 삼림 벌채가 이를 막아 CO2가 늘고 지구 온도가 상승한다는 내용. ④가 주제이다.
theme.distractor_ko: ①나무 성장 속도, ②산소 수송, ③겨울 광합성, ⑤꽃 심기는 본문의 핵심이 아니다.

passage: We should not view forests as mere scenery that we can clear away without cost.
Trees play a huge part in the carbon cycle, turning CO2 into oxygen by photosynthesis.
In this way they serve as nature's own regulators of carbon dioxide.
We must accept that destroying forests cripples this vital service.
With half the world's forests gone, carbon dioxide in the air keeps rising.
That extra CO2 traps the sun's heat and pushes the planet's temperature upward.
We ought to protect and restore forests, for they are our defense against warming.
Saving trees is not sentiment but a practical answer to a global problem.
choices: 나무는 도시 미관을 위해 더 많이 심어야 한다.
이산화탄소는 식물에게 해롭지 않으므로 걱정할 필요가 없다.
삼림은 지구온난화를 막는 방어선이므로 보호하고 복원해야 한다.
광합성은 산소보다 이산화탄소를 더 많이 만들어 낸다.
claim.explanation_ko: 삼림이 CO2를 조절해 온난화를 막으므로 보호·복원해야 한다는 주장. ③이 정답.
claim.distractor_ko: ①미관, ②CO2 무해, ④광합성 오해, ⑤배기가스는 본문 주장과 어긋나거나 무관하다.

passage: About a fifth of global greenhouse gas emissions arise from deforestation and forest decline.
Trees matter greatly in the carbon cycle.
By photosynthesis they convert CO2 into oxygen, regulating carbon dioxide naturally.
So more trees lower carbon dioxide and raise oxygen in the atmosphere.
Unhappily, deforestation blocks this natural process.
With half the forests gone, carbon dioxide steadily increases.
The added CO2 holds in more solar heat, lifting the planet's temperature.
choices: 나무는 산소보다 이산화탄소를 더 많이 흡수한다.
삼림 벌채가 이산화탄소를 늘려 지구 온도를 끌어올린다.
gist.explanation_ko: 나무는 CO2를 조절하지만 삼림 벌채가 이를 막아 CO2가 늘고 지구 온도가 오른다는 것이 요지. ⑤가 정답.
gist.distractor_ko: ①흡수량 비교, ②야간 광합성, ③바다, ④강수량은 요지가 아니다.

passage: Forests do far more than fill the horizon with green.
Trees are key workers in the carbon cycle, turning CO2 into oxygen through photosynthesis.
More forest means less carbon dioxide and a richer supply of oxygen.
But every felled forest weakens this quiet, life-supporting machinery.
Half of Earth's forests are already gone, and carbon dioxide rises year by year.
The thicker blanket of CO2 traps the sun's heat near the ground.
And so, tree by tree, the world grows warmer.
choices: The Hidden Beauty of the World's Green Horizons
Why Oxygen Is the Most Important Gas on Earth
When Forests Fall: How Deforestation Heats the Planet
Photosynthesis: A Process That Works Only by Day
How Cities Can Be Cooled by Planting Flowers
title.explanation_ko: 삼림 벌채가 CO2를 늘려 지구를 데운다는 핵심을 압축한 ③이 제목.
title.distractor_ko: ①숲의 아름다움, ②산소 예찬, ④광합성 시간, ⑤도시 냉각은 글의 초점이 아니다.

passage: Trees are quiet but tireless workers in the carbon cycle.
Through photosynthesis they take in CO2 and give back oxygen, regulating the air.
So a forest is a natural thermostat, holding carbon dioxide in check.
But when we cut the forests down, we break that thermostat.
Half of Earth's forests are gone, and carbon dioxide climbs higher each year.
The thickening CO2 traps the sun's heat instead of letting it escape.
Pull out enough trees, and the planet's fever rises.
implication.underlined: a forest is a natural thermostat
choices: forests can be replaced by machines that cool the air
forests naturally keep carbon dioxide, and thus heat, under control
trees feel temperature the way humans feel a fever
every forest contains a hidden source of warmth
thermostats work better in cold climates than warm ones
implication.explanation_ko: '숲은 자연의 온도조절기'라는 비유는 숲이 CO2를, 따라서 열을 자연스럽게 조절·억제한다는 뜻이다. ②가 정답.
implication.distractor_ko: ①기계 대체, ③열 감지, ④내부 열원, ⑤추운 기후는 비유의 의미와 다르다.

passage: Trees play a huge role in the carbon cycle.
They convert the CO2 in the air to oxygen through the process of photosynthesis.
Consequently, they is viewed as a natural regulator of carbon dioxide.
The existence of more trees will lead to less carbon dioxide and more oxygen.
Unfortunately, deforestation is preventing this process from being fully accomplished.
With more carbon dioxide, more of the sun's radiation is being reflected back to Earth.
Accordingly, deforestation is a major issue when it comes to global warming.
grammar.explanation_ko: ③ 주어 'they(= Trees)' 는 복수이므로 단수 동사 'is viewed' 가 아니라 복수 동사 'are viewed' 가 와야 한다. ③이 정답.
grammar.distractor_ko: ①복수주어 Trees + play, ②convert A to B의 to oxygen, ④prevent ~ from + 동명사 수동형 being accomplished, ⑤수동·진행 is being reflected(반사되고 있다)는 모두 옳다.

passage: Trees play a minor role in the carbon cycle.
Through photosynthesis they convert the CO2 in the air to oxygen.
Consequently, they are seen as a natural regulator of carbon dioxide.
A larger number of trees leads to less carbon dioxide and more oxygen in the air.
Unfortunately, deforestation prevents this process from being fully accomplished.
With more carbon dioxide, more of the sun's heat is trapped near the planet rather than released.
Accordingly, deforestation is a major issue when it comes to global warming.
vocab.explanation_ko: ① 나무는 탄소 순환에서 '큰(huge)' 역할을 한다는 것이 글 전체의 전제이다. '사소한(minor)'은 정반대 의미라 부적절하므로 huge 로 고쳐야 한다. ①이 정답.
vocab.distractor_ko: ②convert(전환하다), ③regulator(조절자), ④prevents(막다), ⑤trapped(갇힌)는 문맥에 적절하다.

passage: Trees are vital to the carbon cycle.
By photosynthesis they turn CO2 into oxygen, acting as natural regulators of carbon dioxide.
So more trees mean less CO2 and more oxygen in the atmosphere.
Unfortunately, deforestation __________.
With half of Earth's forests gone, carbon dioxide keeps rising.
The extra CO2 traps the sun's heat instead of letting it escape into space.
As a result, the planet's average temperature continues to climb.
choices: produces large amounts of fresh oxygen
cools the planet by removing old trees
increases the number of trees worldwide
prevents this carbon-regulating process from working
has no real effect on the carbon cycle
blank.explanation_ko: 나무가 CO2를 조절하지만, 삼림 벌채는 그 '탄소 조절 과정을 막는다(prevents this process from working)'. 그래서 뒤에서 CO2가 계속 늘어난다. ④가 정답.
blank.distractor_ko: ①산소 생산, ②냉각, ③나무 증가, ⑤무영향은 뒤따르는 CO2 상승과 모순된다.

irrelevant.intro: Trees play a huge role in the carbon cycle, converting the CO2 in the air to oxygen through photosynthesis.
sentences: Because of this, they are viewed as a natural regulator of carbon dioxide in the atmosphere.
A larger number of trees leads to less carbon dioxide and more oxygen in the air.
Bamboo flooring has become a popular choice for modern homes because it looks elegant.
Unfortunately, deforestation prevents this process from being fully accomplished.
With half of Earth's forests gone, the amount of carbon dioxide is progressively rising.
irrelevant.explanation_ko: 글은 '나무의 CO2 조절 → 삼림 벌채로 CO2 증가'의 흐름인데 ③ '대나무 바닥재의 인기'는 무관하다.
irrelevant.distractor_ko: ①②④⑤는 모두 나무와 이산화탄소 조절, 삼림 벌채의 영향이라는 흐름에 연결된다.

order.given: Approximately 15-20% of global greenhouse gas emissions are caused by degradation and deforestation. Trees play a huge role in the carbon cycle.

blocks.A: Unfortunately, deforestation is preventing this process from being fully accomplished. And with half of the Earth's forests gone, the amount of carbon dioxide is progressively rising.
blocks.B: They convert the CO2 in the air to oxygen through photosynthesis, and so they are viewed as a natural regulator of carbon dioxide. A larger amount of trees will lead to less carbon dioxide and more oxygen.
blocks.C: With more carbon dioxide in the atmosphere, more of the sun's radiation is reflected back to Earth instead of being released into space, causing the planet's temperature to rise.

order.explanation_ko: 주어진 글이 '나무가 탄소 순환에서 큰 역할'이라 하면, (B)가 그 역할(광합성·CO2 조절)을 설명하고, (A)가 'Unfortunately ... 삼림 벌채가 이를 막아 CO2가 증가'함을 잇고, (C)가 그 증가된 CO2가 온도를 올리는 결과를 제시한다. (B)-(A)-(C).
order.distractor_ko: (C)의 온도 상승은 CO2 증가(A) 이후의 결과이므로 먼저 올 수 없고, (A)의 'this process' 는 (B)의 CO2 조절 과정을 받아야 한다.

insert.insert_sentence: Unfortunately, deforestation is preventing this process from being fully accomplished.

passage_marked.text: Trees play a huge role in the carbon cycle.
They convert the CO2 in the air to oxygen through the process of photosynthesis.
Consequently, they are viewed as a natural regulator of carbon dioxide.
The existence of a larger amount of trees will lead to less carbon dioxide and more oxygen.
And with half of the Earth's forests gone, the amount of carbon dioxide is progressively rising.

insert.explanation_ko: 주어진 문장은 'Unfortunately ... 삼림 벌채가 이 과정을 막는다'로, 나무가 CO2를 줄인다는 긍정 진술(④ 문장) 다음, 그리고 'And ... 숲의 절반이 사라져 CO2가 증가한다'는 문장 앞의 전환 자리에 와야 한다. ④가 정답.
insert.distractor_ko: ④에 넣지 않으면 'this process(이 과정)'가 가리킬 탄소 조절 과정과, 뒤이은 CO2 증가의 논리적 연결이 끊긴다.

passage: Trees are essential to the carbon cycle.
By photosynthesis they convert CO2 into oxygen, regulating carbon dioxide naturally.
More trees therefore mean less CO2 and more oxygen.
Unfortunately, deforestation prevents this process from working fully.
With half the forests gone, carbon dioxide keeps rising.
The extra CO2 traps the sun's heat near Earth.
And so the planet's average temperature climbs.
summary.summary_template: Forests naturally __(A)__ carbon dioxide, so when deforestation destroys them, CO2 builds up and the planet's temperature __(B)__.
summary.explanation_ko: 숲은 CO2를 (A)줄이는데(reduce), 삼림 벌채로 숲이 사라지면 CO2가 쌓여 지구 온도가 (B)오른다(rises). ③.
summary.distractor_ko: (A)는 increase/ignore 가 아니라 reduce, (B)는 falls/stays/freezes 가 아니라 rises 여야 한다.

writing.question: 다음 우리말과 같은 뜻이 되도록 <보기>의 단어를 모두 배열하여 영작하시오.
writing.ko_prompt: 나무는 탄소 순환에서 큰 역할을 한다.
writing.answer: Trees play a huge role in the carbon cycle.
writing.explanation_ko: 주어 Trees + play a huge role(큰 역할을 하다) + in the carbon cycle.

writing.question: 다음 우리말과 같은 뜻이 되도록 <보기>의 단어를 모두 배열하여 영작하시오.
writing.ko_prompt: 그것들은 공기 중의 이산화탄소를 산소로 전환한다.
writing.answer: They convert the CO2 in the air to oxygen.
writing.explanation_ko: convert A to B(A를 B로 전환하다): convert the CO2 in the air to oxygen.

writing.question: 다음 우리말을 <조건>에 맞게 영작하시오.
writing.ko_prompt: 안타깝게도, 삼림 벌채가 이 과정을 막고 있다.
writing.answer: Unfortunately, deforestation is preventing this process from being accomplished.
writing.explanation_ko: Unfortunately + 현재진행 is preventing + prevent A from -ing(A가 ~하는 것을 막다).

writing.question: 다음 글을 읽고, 흐름상 빈칸에 들어갈 한 단어를 본문에서 찾아 쓰시오.
writing.context: Because they turn CO2 into oxygen, trees are viewed as a natural ___________ of carbon dioxide.
writing.explanation_ko: 나무는 CO2를 산소로 바꾸므로 이산화탄소의 자연적 '조절자(regulator)'로 여겨진다.

writing.question: 다음 밑줄 친 문장을 우리말로 해석하시오.
writing.en_prompt: With more carbon dioxide in the atmosphere, more of the sun's radiation is being reflected back to Earth instead of being released into space.
writing.answer: 대기 중에 이산화탄소가 더 많아지면서, 태양 복사의 더 많은 부분이 우주로 방출되는 대신 지구로 다시 반사되고 있다.
writing.explanation_ko: With + 명사구(분사구문 대용), is being reflected(반사되고 있다), instead of being released(방출되는 대신).
